name: claim-check
description: Verification hooks for agentic coding: report what a session transcript can and cannot show about what the agent said it did, and check a scoped test claim against a pytest receipt.

plugins.name: claim-check
plugins.description: It told you the tests passed. What is that based on? Reports what the transcript can and cannot show about each claim in the agent's final message, and checks a scoped test claim against an opt-in pytest receipt. Report-only.
